label: PE16
title: Boundary-integral equations and Galerkin BEM
description: {"scope": "Define single/double-layer potentials, boundary traces/jumps, Calderon operators and Galerkin BEM for 3D Laplace on a closed orientable Lipschitz polyhedral boundary. Prove bounded mappings in H±1/2 trace spaces, correct signed jump identities and ellipticity modulo stated constants/kernel; prove unique stabilized formulation and quasi-optimal error under a shape-regular surface family. Treat 2D logarithmic capacity/scaling separately. Helmholtz combined-field extension consumes PE18 uniqueness and carries frequency-dependent inverse bounds. Quadrature and FMM acceleration have separately controlled matrix perturbation error; they are not free exact BEM.", "proof_route": "Build Lipschitz trace/lift and dual normal trace, weak layer potentials by variational transmission, then prove singular-kernel representation agrees and derive jumps by transmission/Green. Positivity of single layer from whole-space energy; quotient/gauge removal, Lax–Milgram and NA29 Galerkin. Surface interpolation in fractional norms via a proved local norm/scaling estimate. For Helmholtz use compact perturbation and a locally proved Fredholm alternative plus uniqueness. Kernel principal-value and jump signs are computed, not memorized.", "examples": "sphere constant density, jump sign orientation, polyhedral singularity, inexact assembly ledger."}
